title: Configure roles and permission boundaries
prerequisites: A disposable custom role and an account for supervised permission verification.

scenes.title: Find the workflow
scenes.narration: Roles group permissions for people doing similar work. Open Roles and review the existing roles before creating another. The owner role has special authority; ordinary staff should receive only the capabilities their job requires.

scenes.title: Understand the controls
scenes.narration: Create a custom role when the built-in choices do not fit. Use a clear name and description. Permission groups distinguish reading data from managing it, and order fulfilment, payment, refund and courier reconciliation are separate capabilities.

scenes.title: Perform the task
scenes.narration: Open the role detail page to inspect or edit supported permissions. Save deliberately and review the result. Resetting or deleting roles has separate controls and may be restricted for built-in or referenced roles.

scenes.title: Verify and continue
scenes.narration: Verify access using a suitable isolated account, including a denied action as well as an allowed one. Hiding a navigation item is not the whole access boundary: server authorization must still apply. Keep the role understandable to the next administrator.
